key_insight: LaGO uses a pretrained LLM as a soft latent action prior to guide online reinforcement learning, improving policy optimization without relying on the LLM as a direct controller.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to inject high-level language knowledge into RL systems while reducing the brittleness of explicit action generation in real control tasks.
method: Treat the LLM as a latent action guide rather than a planner/controller
Use the latent prior to softly steer online policy optimization
Train and evaluate with PPO on both discrete and continuous control benchmarks
evidence_signal: Across CLEVR-Robot and Meta-World, LaGO outperforms Vanilla PPO, raising success rate from 15.1% to 27.2% and from 2.7% to 15.2%, respectively.
watch_item: The approach depends on pretrained LLM quality, so weak or mismatched models may provide limited or noisy guidance and add integration complexity.
paper_title: LaGO: Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning
